sentences.en: I want some information on self-drive tours in the USA
sentences.zh: 我想了解一下美国的自驾游信息。

sentences.en: Could you send me a brochure?
sentences.zh: 您能给我寄一份宣传册吗？

sentences.en: TRAVEL AGENT: Can you spell that?
sentences.zh: TRAVEL AGENT: 您能拼写一下吗？

sentences.en: And can I have your phone number?
sentences.zh: 另外，我可以知道您的电话号码吗？

sentences.en: And can I ask you where you heard about World Tours?
sentences.zh: 另外，我可以问一下您是从哪里了解到World Tours的吗？

sentences.en: Or did you see an advert somewhere?
sentences.zh: 还是您在某处看到了广告？

sentences.en: ANDREA: No, I read about you in the newspaper
sentences.zh: ANDREA: 不是，我在报纸上看到贵公司的介绍。

sentences.en: TRAVEL AGENT: OK, I'll get the brochures in the post to you but can I give you some information over the phone
sentences.zh: TRAVEL AGENT: 好的，我会把宣传册邮寄给您，不过我也可以先通过电话为您提供一些信息。

sentences.en: What kinds of things do you want to do on your holiday?
sentences.zh: 您希望在假期中做些什么活动呢？

sentences.en: ANDREA: I'm interested in going to California with my family
sentences.zh: ANDREA: 我打算和家人一起去加利福尼亚州旅游。

sentences.en: I've got two children and we want to hire a car
sentences.zh: 我有两个孩子，我们想租一辆车。

sentences.en: We have a couple of self-drive tours there visiting different places of interest in California
sentences.zh: 我们在那里有几条自驾游线路，会带您游览加利福尼亚州的不同景点。

sentences.en: The first one begins in Los Angeles and there's plenty of time to visit some of the theme parks there
sentences.zh: 第一条线路从洛杉矶开始，您将有充足的时间参观那里的主题公园。

sentences.en: ANDREA: That's something on my children's list so I'd want to include that
sentences.zh: ANDREA: 这是我孩子们最想去的地方之一，所以我想把这项安排进去。

sentences.en: Then you drive to San Francisco
sentences.zh: 接着您将驾车前往旧金山。

sentences.en: From San Francisco you can drive to Yosemite Park where you spend a couple of nights
sentences.zh: 从旧金山出发，您可以驱车前往优胜美地国家公园，在那里停留两晚。

sentences.en: You can choose to stay in a lodge or on the campsite
sentences.zh: 您可以选择住在小木屋或露营地。

sentences.en: ANDREA: don't like the idea of a staying in a tent
sentences.zh: ANDREA: 我不喜欢住在帐篷里的想法。

sentences.en: And the tour ends in Las Vegas
sentences.zh: 而且这次旅行在拉斯维加斯结束。

sentences.en: TRAVEL AGENT: The other trip we can arrange is slightly different
sentences.zh: TRAVEL AGENT: 我们能安排的另一趟行程略有不同。

sentences.en: It starts It in San Francisco
Then you drive south to Cambria
sentences.zh: 然后你们一路向南开车前往坎布里亚。

sentences.en: ANDREA: Someone told me there's a really nice castle near Cambria
sentences.zh: ANDREA: 有人告诉我坎布里亚附近有一座非常漂亮的城堡。

sentences.en: TRAVEL AGENT: Hearst Castle is on that road sO you could stop there
sentences.zh: TRAVEL AGENT: 赫氏古堡就在那条路上，所以你们可以顺道停下来参观。

sentences.en: Does this trip also go into the desert?
sentences.zh: 这次行程也会进入沙漠吗？

sentences.en: TRAVEL AGENT: No, it continues to Santa Monica where most people like to stop and do some shopping
sentences.zh: TRAVEL AGENT: 不会，行程会继续前往圣莫尼卡，大多数游客喜欢在那里停留并购物。

sentences.en: ANDREA: We have enough of that at home so that doesn't interest us
sentences.zh: ANDREA: 我们在家已经买够了，所以这对我们没有吸引力。
